items.stem: 4 coins are tossed 160 times and the following results were obtained:  No. of heads 0 1 2 3 4  Observed frequencies 17 52 54 31 6  Under the assumption that the coins are unbiased, we obtain the expected frequencies of getting 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 heads and tested the goodness of fit. Applying the χ2 test for goodness of fit, the calculated value of χ2 comes out to be:
items.explanation: Official answer C. Response sheet Q72; you marked B — wrong.

items.stem: Match the LIST-I with LIST-II  LIST-I LIST-II  A. Testing equality of means of two populations when population variances are known I. χ2 - test  B. Testing equality of variances of two normal populations II. t - test  C. Testing equality of several population proportions III. F - test  D. Testing significance of mean in a single population with unknown variance IV. Z - test  Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
items.explanation: Official answer C — A-IV, B-III, C-I, D-II. Response sheet Q102; you marked C — correct.

items.stem: The price of crude oil and gasoline over a 10-year period are given below (Rs./l). Crude oil: 77.91, 82.00, 89.20, 73.37, 66.42, 80.10, 69.78, 72.09, 92.14, 96.31. Gasoline: 65.46, 64.18, 65.66, 59.23, 65.68, 69.55, 67.81, 67.39, 82.06, 84.40. The value of Spearman's rank correlation coefficient between the prices of crude oil and gasoline over the 10-year period was:
items.explanation: Rank each series separately (1 = smallest). Crude ranks 5,7,8,4,1,6,2,3,9,10 and gasoline ranks 3,2,4,1,5,8,7,6,9,10, so Σd² = 108 and ρ = 1 − 6(108)/(10 × 99) = 0.3455. Official answer B. Response sheet Q111; you marked C — wrong.
items.check: Rank both series before differencing. Ranking only one, or ranking by value instead of position, is the usual slip.

items.stem: For teaching a foreign language to executives, two groups of 15 executives were ran- domly selected – one group studied the language using the Educational Service (ES) method and the other group studied the language using the Learning Curve (LC) method. The final scores for the two groups, Educational Service (ES) and Learning Curve (LC), as follows:  ES: 65, 57, 74, 43, 39, 88, 62, 69, 70, 72, 59, 60, 80, 83, 50  LC: 85, 87, 92, 98, 90, 88, 75, 72, 60, 93, 88, 89, 96, 73, 62  To compare the effectiveness of the two methods ES and LC, Mann-Whitney U-test was applied. The value of Mann-Whitney U-statistic for this problem will be:
items.explanation: Official answer A. Response sheet Q106; you marked C — wrong.
